cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In the quiz-club newsletter, say I earned the trophy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that in. I studied birds for six months and got all twelve right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call the questions lucky and my answers earned.

reason: Move the credit dispute into an editable newsletter account, let B keep the factual luck context, and replace feather metaphors with a precise attribution request.
